name: Tendou Mitsuhiko
source: [url=/c14023]Yuusuke's[/url] classmate who is a member of the photography club. He mainly takes pictures of the girls in their school, and doesn't feel guilty about it because he doesn't see girls' bodies as anything else but art. According to him, there is nothing more beautiful in the world than a woman's naked body.
